name: @ros-chromium/sim-driver
description: Glues the standalone simulator (../../../simulator) to pathfinder's closed-loop control relay: connects to the simulator's Roboteq (:8765) and sensor (:8766) endpoints like a real dashboard would, runs PathFollowerNode against the sensor stream's ground-truth pose, and relays that same pose to pathfinder's /api/live-pose so it shows on the real map too. Not a browser page -- everything it touches (WebSocketTransport, LocalBus) already runs unmodified in Node 22+.
